purpose: Teach: バリー/メアリー/ラッセル/ジェリー/エド/エドワード/ブラッド/アニー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ボンドのバリー・ニールセン覚えてたな
lines.en: Riku, you actually remembered Barry Nelson playing Bond.
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing smirk. Quick, sharp attack on the name. Drawing him into a game she's already winning. Testing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語教科書でメアリーって名前出てきたな、桜
lines.en: You remembered Mary from the English textbook, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, quick comeback. Matching her game with equal wit. Light but pointed—no heat, just the rhythm of two people who know how to needle each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でラッセル卿の名前覚えたな
lines.en: Riku, you actually remembered Earl Russell from that history class.
lines.style: Pressing the game forward. Slightly louder, more insistent. She's building a case and she knows it. Relishing the moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トムとジェリーのアニメ動画よく観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched Tom and Jerry videos all the time, Sakura.
lines.style: Mild defense wrapped in dry humor. Slower than her volleys—he's catching his breath between rounds. Not angry, just... steady counterargument.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、エド・シーランのギターでカバーしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were the one doing Ed Sheeran covers on guitar.
lines.style: Triumphant and warm. Landing a real point. Her voice lifts slightly—this one matters more. Not mocking anymore; almost admiring beneath the tease.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でエドワード王知ってるよな、桜
lines.en: You know about King Edward from history, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet turn inward. His voice softens. He's stopped trading jabs and is asking something that feels less like a game. Vulnerable underneath the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ブラッド・ピットの映画一気見してたな
lines.en: Riku, you watched through Brad Pitt's entire filmography in one sitting.
lines.style: Last volley, but her edge is gentler now. She's not trying to win anymore. Observing. Almost fond. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭でアニーのソング歌ったろ、桜
lines.en: You sang Annie at the culture festival, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closing moment. Warm and direct. He's met her somewhere soft. No more games—just the truth of what he noticed about her. Close, quiet, certain.
